The 0.35 to 0.375 pattern is pixel-sensitive. The matched-window core night difference remains -936/-758 ppm, but its block-proxy intervals include zero and each night retains its own reference/GP history.
The 17 observed native rectangular corrections are full rank only within their assumed finite basis. Complete-band displays have rank 12 or 15, and intrinsic phase attribution remains nonunique.
